current_contracts.browser_retry: same request_id and repeat_id; new export_attempt_id; append attempt manifest record; optional validated replacement of the repeat file
current_contracts.control_pairing: deterministic controls exist, but optional planning uses up to three controls on five mini-pilot episodes and has no explicit matched_pair_id
current_contracts.full_plan: 40 episodes x 5 standardized batches x one initial repeat = 200 rows
current_contracts.import_accumulation: one CSV/sidecar command at a time; logically appends unseen observation identities while physically rewriting the canonical Parquet
current_contracts.mini_pilot: five episodes x five batches at repeat_1 plus Florida Batch 1 repeat_2 = 26 rows and 25 logical request IDs
current_contracts.plan_row: one planned export execution for one logical episode/geography/window/panel definition and one planned repeat
current_contracts.request_id_generation: SHA-256 of canonical episode, geography, request window, category, search property, backend, ordered concepts, batch_id, and terminology version
current_contracts.repeat_identity: planned_repeat_id in plan; repeat_id in browser manifest, sidecar, and imported observations

requirements.proposed_change: Extend trends plan with a deterministic --episode-limit selector applied to the supplied 40-episode pilot, with an explicit nesting rule for 10 and 20.
requirements.requirement: deterministic selection of 10 episodes from the 40-episode pilot
requirements.schema_impact: Add selection_scope, execution_selection_rank, and selection rule/version to the execution plan or summary.
requirements.test_impact: Add deterministic 10-of-40, 20-of-40, nested-subset, diversity, and invalid-limit tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Use rank-1 selected control per episode, generate the treated and control rows from the same episode and panel, and validate one-to-one balance.
requirements.schema_impact: Add deterministic matched_pair_id shared by treated/control logical requests and their repeats.
requirements.test_impact: Add missing-control, extra-control, role-balance, shared-pair-ID, panel-alignment, and deterministic rank-1 tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Add trends plan --execution-only and write one exact acquisition_execution_plan artifact with pre-write cardinality validation.
requirements.schema_impact: Add execution_batch_id, matched_pair_id, execution_selection_rank, and an execution-plan schema/version.
requirements.test_impact: Add exact artifact-set, exact row-count, stable schema, and no exploratory-row leakage tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Add --planned-repeats 2 and deterministically expand every logical request after computing its repeat-invariant request_id.
requirements.requirement: exactly two planned repeats per logical request
requirements.schema_impact: Use planned_repeat_id values repeat_1 and repeat_2 on every execution row; no new identity field is required.
requirements.test_impact: Add zero/one/two/many repeat option tests and exact per-request repeat-count validation.

requirements.proposed_change: Preserve the current hash contract and add an invariant test across repeat expansion.
requirements.test_impact: Generalize the existing Florida-only assertion to all execution-plan logical requests.

requirements.proposed_change: Generate unique planned_repeat_id and filenames for every expanded row and reject duplicate request/repeat keys.
requirements.schema_impact: None beyond making planned_repeat_id mandatory in the execution-plan schema.
requirements.test_impact: Add duplicate planned-repeat, filename-collision, and CSV/Parquet equivalence tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Document and retain the current attempt contract; do not convert retries into repeats.
requirements.requirement: export attempt identity separate from repeat identity
requirements.test_impact: Retain retry-history tests and add an explicit assertion that request_id and repeat_id remain unchanged.

requirements.proposed_change: Restrict the execution plan to batch_1_flood_awareness and validate its exact ordered panel.
requirements.schema_impact: None; concept_ids and batch_id already exist.
requirements.test_impact: Add fixed five-concept order and disallowed-extra-batch tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Extend validate-imports with strict full plan/repeat, raw-file, panel, role-pair, and execution-batch completeness checks.
requirements.schema_impact: Add a deterministic completeness-report schema; observations schema need not change.
requirements.test_impact: Add missing/unexpected repeat, raw file, sidecar, concept, role, pair, and batch tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Group source CSV hashes during strict validation and emit non-fatal duplicate-hash review records.
requirements.requirement: duplicate-file hash reporting without automatic rejection
requirements.schema_impact: Add duplicate_raw_hashes.csv or an equivalent deterministic report section.
requirements.test_impact: Add same-hash/different-plan reporting, deterministic ordering, and non-fatal validity tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Add import-csv --import-manifest and a cumulative deterministic import ledger while preserving single-file mode.
requirements.requirement: batch import or deterministic import manifest
requirements.schema_impact: Add import-manifest and import-ledger schemas; observations schema is unchanged.
requirements.test_impact: Add 40/80-entry manifest, idempotence, partial failure, ordering, duplicate source, and hash tests.

requirements.proposed_change: Require strict acquisition completeness before downstream metrics and use the exact repeat-specific execution plan as the integration plan.
requirements.schema_impact: No integrated-schema change; execution plan adds complete repeat-specific lineage.
requirements.test_impact: Add acquisition-to-integration test asserting zero unmatched and orphan records for the exact execution plan.
